technical.summary: Strong volume spike and MACD/PPO crossovers with price above all major MAs, but weak trend strength (ADX 18), overbought oscillators, and short-term MA misalignment limit conviction for swing entry.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (317), strong dollar pressures multinationals, and earnings in 47 days add event risk to already toxic environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Volume spike (15x), MACD/PPO bullish crossovers, price above all major MAs, and extreme fear sentiment (19/100) create a classic contrarian reversal setup with defined support at 467.56.
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak trend strength (ADX 18), overbought oscillators (StochRSI, Williams %R), short-term MA misalignment, zero fundamental conviction, earnings event risk in 47 days, and severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar) overwhelm technical signals.
